title: x402 alternative path: upfront flow with the exact scheme on Lightning
summary: Lightning has no way to pull a signed authorization later, so the lnbtc binding uses the upfront flow: the client pays a BOLT11 invoice first, sends the preimage, the facilitator settles by checking the preimage, and only then does the server run the handler. There is no /verify call and no refund path.

steps.label: GET /article/A
steps.detail: The client asks for a paid article.

steps.label: 402 with a fresh BOLT11 invoice
steps.detail: The server mints a new invoice for this exact request. The requirements name the lnbtc network, asset BTC, an amount in millisatoshis (25000 is 25 satoshis), payTo as the node key, paymentFlow upfront, and a requestHash that binds the invoice to the request.

steps.label: Pay the invoice
steps.detail: The client pays the invoice over Lightning and receives the 32-byte preimage as proof.

failures.condition: The invoice expired (maxTimeoutSeconds equals the invoice expiry)
failures.outcome: The payment fails; the client requests a new 402.

steps.label: Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (preimage)
steps.detail: The payload carries only the preimage; there is no macaroon.

steps.label: POST /settle (no /verify)
steps.detail: The upfront ordering is settle, resource, respond. The facilitator checks that SHA-256 of the preimage equals the invoice payment hash, that the invoice was signed by payTo, and records the payment hash in a replay store atomically.

failures.condition: The preimage does not match, or the payment hash was already recorded
failures.outcome: Settle fails and the handler does not run. A replay is refused.

steps.label: Return SettleResponse success true
steps.detail: Validity is established by settle itself.

steps.label: Run the handler
steps.detail: The client has already paid. If the handler fails now, the client is charged and the protocol defines no refund.

failures.outcome: The client paid for nothing; any remedy is the server's own arrangement.

steps.label: 200 OK with PAYMENT-RESPONSE
steps.detail: The server returns the article and the settlement result.
